newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's cuts debt ratings of Mitsui Fudosan, units.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts debt ratings of Mitsui Fudosan, units.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday that it had cut the long-term and short-term debt ratings of Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd and two of its units to A3/Prime-2 from A2/Prime-1.
The downgrade reflects the property firm's impaired capital resources and Moody's expectation of a modest profit recovery for Mitsui Fudosan, Moody's said in a statement.
The action concludes the review started in November last year, it said.

The debt instruments and programmes affected by the downgrade are Mitsui Fudosan's senior unsecured bonds totalling 160 billion yen, its 200 billion yen domestic shelf registration, and its domestic commercial paper programme, Moody's said.
Mitsui Fudosan International Capital Inc's $1 billion global medium-term note programme and Mitsui Fudosan (New York) Inc's U.S. commercial paper programme are also affected, Moody's said.
